decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom serves a small but growing niche, launched only in 2019. Its value is still uncertain, and keeping it open as a low-cost option on future proton center demand is sensible.
Small volume ionization chambers are long-lived, certified dosimetry products with steady demand from small-field and stereotactic treatment. They cost little to keep in the portfolio.
This chamber complements the other small-field variant in a stable, regulated market. Nothing suggests its value has failed to materialize.
A standard clinical chamber is a core product in the firm's established dosimetry line. Its repeated website presence signals it is part of the ongoing business.
Relative dosimetry chambers are routinely used with water phantoms and sell alongside other products. The cost of keeping this one available is small.
Thimble chambers have long life cycles in clinical dosimetry. There is no evidence of weak results that would justify abandoning this one.
